statement:
Problem 1

Find more integers $d$ and $n$ such that a general hypersurface of degree $d$ in $\mathbb P^n_{\mathbb C}$ is unirational.
Similarly,
find more integers $d$ and $n$ such that every smooth hypersurface of degree $d$ in $\mathbb P^n_{\mathbb C}$ is unirational.
title: Seed-preserving explicit bounds for unirational hypersurfaces
